reviews.comment: Many people get thrown off that this class is more philosophical than technical, but with that in mind Shell is a great prof. reviews.comment: Dr. Shell and the TA provide helpful, although sometimes pedantic, guidance. Your grade highly depends on your other group members. If you have trustworthy friends taking capstone and want to produce a worthwhile project, take him.

reviews.comment: Dr. Shell is the best professor I've had at A&M. Great guy who cares a lot about students' success and puts tons of effort into the class. The TA, Kyle, was also excellent. reviews.comment: I can't recommend capstone with Dr. Shell enough. His weekly meetings with our team were informative and to-the-point. Highly recommend for the amount of creative freedom and team choice he provided.
